notes.title: v0.23.5 - Fixed Steam Lobby issue
notes.content: Fixed the issue where you couldn't join or host a lobby after leaving another lobby. Also nerfed party poppers

notes.title: v0.20.1 - silly bug fix
notes.content: Fixed the silly bug where half the players would spawn on the red team in free for all

notes.title: v0.19.4 - Bug fixes and more consistent jumping
notes.content: Changed the way that the drag/friction on the player works, which should make your jump height more consistent. Other important bug fixes were also done

notes.title: v0.19.2 - Meteor map fix
notes.content: Added a skybox to the meteor map, fixed the gravity when getting the map multiple times in a row and added a map border to prevent flying super far away

notes.title: v0.17.1 - Rocket Launcher changes
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I've fixed some bugs and improved the rocket launcher!

Rocket launcher changes:

[list]
[*]Explosion radius - 9m > 5.7m
[*]Added sounds for the rocket travelling
[*]Added new achievement - To the Moon!
[*]Fixed rocket not disappearing after exploding
[/list]

Enjoy the update! ːsteamhappyː ːsteamhappyː ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: v0.16.4 - Game start timer
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Game will not start until all players have deployed, until then, player cannot move or shoot.
[*]Fractal map is brighter
[*]Points are no longer gained in King of The Hill if you are alone in a lobby
[/list]

notes.title: v0.16.3 - KOTH changes
notes.content:
[list]
[*]• The King of The Hill zone shader has been revamped and is also visible from both sides.
[*]• Shooting at the king of the hill zone has some visual effects and sounds now
[*]• Seconds per point in KOTH zone 0.5s > 0.8s
[*]• Ocean and Mansion can no longer be played in KOTH gamemode
[*]• Weapon clipping has been fixed
[/list]

notes.title: Bug fixes and new achievement
notes.content: Fixed all the bugs I found with the previous update and added a new achievement for getting 10 wins. Achievements no longer get reset when launching the game

notes.title: Achievement Update
notes.content: 3 new achievements have been added, also sniper damage has been nerfed from 77 to 70, so you need 3 compressed ammos to make it do 100 damage.

notes.title: Small character customization update
notes.content: You can now see your character when in the character customizer ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content: fixed most of the bugs with the new class select system bugs and improved ability stacking

notes.title: Decently big update
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I've completely revamped the ocean map, fixed some bugs, made some balancing changes i forgor and also added 2 achievements!

notes.title: Small update (again)
notes.content:
Better regeneration - faster regeneration, but you don't regenerate health if less than 10 seconds have passed since the last time you took damage.

Health no longer goes below 0

Ranged rifle nerf (40 damage - 35 damage)

Shotgun - less spread (i have no idea how my spread function works so i cant say how much it changed cuz im stupid)

Better settings menu

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
Added a low pass filter and post-processing effects when low health.

[h2]Weapon changes[/h2]

Shotgun changes (12 damage per pellet - 13 damage per pellet),

Ranged rifle changes (reload speed 2.5s - 3.5s, max ammo 10 - 6),

Charge revolver changes (charge speed 2.5 charge per second - 1.25 charge per second, 2s reload speed - 3.3s reload speed)
